about: The questions an agency can put to many Syms at once. An agency taps one, taps an audience and a price per Sym; it never types a question, so no free text reaches a player or a model. Option traits use the ontology tags.

questions.question: A new product comes out. What makes this person try it?

options.label: A friend says it is good
The reviews and the numbers
It is new and few people have it
A brand they already trust makes it

questions.question: The same item has two prices. Which does this person choose?

options.label: The lower price
The better made one, even at twice the price
The one that feels like a treat today

questions.question: Which message would this person open?

options.label: Here is your plan for the week
A surprise: something new is inside
People like you chose this

questions.question: What makes this person come back?

options.label: It never changes
It often surprises them
It feels like their own

questions.question: What would make this person take a new job?

options.label: A clear path and steady pay
A problem no one has solved
The team
A bigger role

questions.question: What would this person pay to learn?

options.label: A skill that pays within one year
Something they are curious about
What their friends are learning
